name: ai-coding-buddy
description: A struggle-aware AI coding tutor for VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Hint generation and struggle estimates are available in Restricted Mode. Running the active source file always requires confirmation in an untrusted workspace.

codingBuddy.level1TimeLimit.description: Minimum seconds between Level 1 evaluations. Passing time never raises assistance by itself; qualifying error, revision, or navigation evidence is also required.

codingBuddy.level2TimeLimit.description: Minimum seconds between Level 2 evaluations. Passing time never raises assistance by itself; stronger struggle evidence is required.

codingBuddy.level3TimeLimit.description: Minimum seconds between automatic assistance evaluations while at Level 3. Lowering can happen immediately when struggle signals ease.

codingBuddy.pythonPath.description: Python executable path. Leave empty to detect py, python, or python3 automatically.

codingBuddy.javaCompilerPath.description: Java compiler executable used by Run Current File.

codingBuddy.javaRuntimePath.description: Java runtime executable used after compilation.

codingBuddy.cCompilerPath.description: C compiler executable used by Run Current File.

codingBuddy.cppCompilerPath.description: C++ compiler executable used by Run Current File.

codingBuddy.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama generate API URL used for hints.

codingBuddy.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model name used for hints.

codingBuddy.hintTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for a local model hint.

codingBuddy.maxHintSourceLength.description: Maximum number of source characters sent in a hint request. Long files are sampled from the beginning and end.

codingBuddy.modelPath.description: Optional locally trained model path. Custom models require a matching SHA-256 sidecar. Leave empty to use the bundled model.
